description: pact-jvm's ContractTest: three pacts for one provider, v2 with and without a state, and v3 with two parameterised states whose values feed a ProviderState generator on the query. The provider answers GET /data for any of the ticket ids the test's states return, as its WireMock stub does
source: pact-jvm provider/junit5/src/test (Apache-2.0) at 88477ee: resources/pacts/contract.json, contract2.json and contract-v3.json, verified there by ContractTest's @State methods and its WireMock stub. Staged plan S1.15; ADR 0056 decision 5; the JVM SDK's examples verify the same pacts through JanusProviderExtension
